# Set-ZbxMap

## SYNOPSIS

Changes a network map.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxMap [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixMap>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-Line <ZabbixMapUpdateLineRequest[]>] [-Element <ZabbixMapElementRequest[]>] [-BackgroundScale <ZabbixMapBackgroundScale>] [-ShowElementLabel <ZabbixMapShowElementLabel>] [-ShowLinkLabel <ZabbixMapShowElementLabel>] [-Link <ZabbixMapUpdateLinkRequest[]>] [-Width <int>] [-Height <int>] [-BackgroundId <ulong>] [-LabelType <ZabbixMapLabelType>] [-LabelLocation <ZabbixMapLabelLocation>] [-Highlight <bool>] [-ExpandProblem <ZabbixMapExpandProblem>] [-MarkElements <int>] [-ShowUnacknowledged <ZabbixMapShowUnacknowledged>] [-GridSize <int>] [-GridShow <bool>] [-GridAlign <bool>] [-LabelFormat <bool>] [-LabelTypeHost <ZabbixMapLabelType>] [-LabelTypeHostGroup <ZabbixMapLabelType>] [-LabelTypeTrigger <ZabbixMapLabelType>] [-LabelTypeMap <ZabbixMapLabelType>] [-LabelTypeImage <ZabbixMapLabelType>] [-LabelStringHost <string>] [-LabelStringHostGroup <string>] [-LabelStringTrigger <string>] [-LabelStringMap <string>] [-LabelStringImage <string>] [-IconMapId <ulong>] [-ExpandMacros <bool>] [-SeverityMin <ZabbixSeverity>] [-UserId <ulong>] [-Private <bool>] [-ShowSuppressed <bool>] [-Url <ZabbixMapUrlRequest[]>] [-Shape <ZabbixMapUpdateShapeRequest[]>] [-User <ZabbixMapUserRequest[]>] [-UserGroup <ZabbixMapUserGroupRequest[]>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A network map draws hosts, host groups, triggers and other maps as icons joined by links, colored by the problems behind them. The Set-ZbxMap cmdlet changes the network maps given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with map.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every network map the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed network maps back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change a network map

```powershell
Set-ZbxMap -InputObject 'Office map' -Width 1200
```

Makes the network map Office map 1200 pixels wide.

### Example 2: Change a network map and write the result

```powershell
Set-ZbxMap -InputObject 'Office map' -Width 1200 -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the network map Office map back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixMap>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `ZabbixMapUpdateLineRequest[]`: Bound to -Line (ByPropertyName). lines of a ZabbixMapUpdateRequest.
- `ZabbixMapElementRequest[]`: Bound to -Element (ByPropertyName). selements of a ZabbixMapCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixMapBackgroundScale`: Bound to -BackgroundScale (ByPropertyName). The map background scale values: SYSMAP_BACKGROUND_SCALE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixMapShowElementLabel`: Bound to -ShowElementLabel (ByPropertyName), -ShowLinkLabel (ByPropertyName). The map show element label values: MAP_SHOW_LABEL_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixMapUpdateLinkRequest[]`: Bound to -Link (ByPropertyName). links of a ZabbixMapUpdateRequest.
- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName), -LabelStringHost (ByPropertyName), -LabelStringHostGroup (ByPropertyName), -LabelStringTrigger (ByPropertyName), -LabelStringMap (ByPropertyName), -LabelStringImage (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `int`: Bound to -Width (ByPropertyName), -Height (ByPropertyName), -MarkElements (ByPropertyName), -GridSize (ByPropertyName). A number.
- `ulong`: Bound to -BackgroundId (ByPropertyName), -IconMapId (ByPropertyName), -UserId (ByPropertyName).
- `ZabbixMapLabelType`: Bound to -LabelType (ByPropertyName), -LabelTypeHost (ByPropertyName), -LabelTypeHostGroup (ByPropertyName), -LabelTypeTrigger (ByPropertyName), -LabelTypeMap (ByPropertyName), -LabelTypeImage (ByPropertyName). The map label type values: MAP_LABEL_TYPE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixMapLabelLocation`: Bound to -LabelLocation (ByPropertyName). The map label location values: MAP_LABEL_LOC_* in defines.inc.php.
- `bool`: Bound to -Highlight (ByPropertyName), -GridShow (ByPropertyName), -GridAlign (ByPropertyName), -LabelFormat (ByPropertyName), -ExpandMacros (ByPropertyName), -Private (ByPropertyName), -ShowSuppressed (ByPropertyName). True or false.
- `ZabbixMapExpandProblem`: Bound to -ExpandProblem (ByPropertyName). The map expand problem values: SYSMAP_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixMapShowUnacknowledged`: Bound to -ShowUnacknowledged (ByPropertyName). The map show unacknowledged values: EXTACK_OPTION_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixSeverity`: Bound to -SeverityMin (ByPropertyName). A trigger or problem severity.
- `ZabbixMapUrlRequest[]`: Bound to -Url (ByPropertyName). urls of a ZabbixMapCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixMapUpdateShapeRequest[]`: Bound to -Shape (ByPropertyName). shapes of a ZabbixMapUpdateRequest.
- `ZabbixMapUserRequest[]`: Bound to -User (ByPropertyName). users of a ZabbixMapCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixMapUserGroupRequest[]`: Bound to -UserGroup (ByPropertyName). userGroups of a ZabbixMapCreateRequest.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -PipedRecord (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.
